cohort.selection_policy: all .records[].package entries from the frozen Table 2 manifest in existing order; no resampling, replacement, or result filtering

metric_operationalization.allowance: compile_report.overlap_allowances plus valid release registry files; eligible denominator is source-link pairs excluding direct parent-child
metric_operationalization.rebuild: eligible only with a frozen recipe, runner identity, complete bound inputs, and declared canonical output fingerprint
metric_operationalization.receipt: release package receipt must bind URDF, recursive resource closure, protocol, runner, pair policy, thresholds, and conclusion; compile_report is explicitly excluded
metric_operationalization.receipt_replay: missing or non-replayable receipt fails closed
metric_operationalization.registered_allowance: empty registry is exactly equivalent to no allowance; a non-empty registry requires pair-specific replay and is rejected by this frozen run
metric_operationalization.strict_pass: independent reaggregation of frozen unified PyBullet Table 4 rest, single-joint, and Sobol raw state records; penetration threshold 1e-6 m; direct parent-child excluded; no method-specific allowance
